Class MercuryService

public class MercuryService

Methods to interact with Mercury Bank transactions.

Changes

  • 08/09/2021   Initial version.
  • 08/22/2021   The settings are now directly saved to the cache (instead of saving the custom metadata).
  • 08/22/2021   Methods to send ACH payments thru API, to get bank accounts info and to get ACH recipients info.
  • 08/24/2021   Result getAdditionalInfoAsDate() and getAdditionalInfoAsDatetime() methods.
  • 08/29/2021   Adds Mercury settings for additional endpoints, getBankAccount() and getRecipientAccount() methods.
  • 08/30/2021   Adds Mercury settings and method to get payment updates from the Mercury API.
  • 08/31/2021   Methods to edit bank account recipients using the Mercury API.
  • 09/01/2021   getBankAccount() method to get all bank accounts info by calling the Mercury API.
  • 09/10/2025   Updated to use UUID.randomUUID(). API version updated to 64.0.
